To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimizer is able to generate execution plans with optimal performance on in-memory tables.

• Oracle Database In-M Memory provides a new storage option for existing on-disk tables, and the query optimizer is enhanced to take advantage of this new storage option • Oracle Database In-memory introduces a columnar storage format, which is a new data representation that is best suited to meet today’s demands for faster analytics • Oracle Database In- Memory introduces a new cost model for the in-memory columnar storage format • Oracle Database In Memory introduces a new query transformation to convert row major predicates into columnar
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the Oracle Database In-More query optimizer can best exploit the new data representation to improve query performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the query optimizer is the key enabler of Oracle Database In-memory.
the query optimizer has been significantly enhanced to generate the best possible execution plans for Oracle Database In-Memor

, Oracle 12c database in-memory is the industry’s first in-memory database that allows existing on-disk tables, including partitioned, index organized, and materialized views, to have complementary in memory columnar representations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an optimizer that is format-agnostic, i.e. it can generate plans for both formats, and format-specific, i.e. the plans are optimal for the format that will be scanned.

we have made the optimizer more aware of the dual format and the new data processing techniques, and thus more capable of generating optimal execution plans for the in-memory columnar format, and also for the traditional row major format, when appropriate.
the optimizer has been enhanced to support the following: 1) In-Memory Columnar tables 2) Hybrid Columnar Compression 3) Hybrid Columnar tables 4) In-Memory tables 5) In-Memory Hybrid Columnar tables
The main takeaway from our work is that
the query optimizer is the most important part of the database that needs to be enhanced to support the new storage format.
a dual-format database can be optimized for both storage formats and that query plans can be generated for either storage format, depending on the availability of the data.
a query optimizer must be able to adapt its execution strategies to different data formats and storage mechanisms.
